basic_details.post_name: Senior Resident (Obs & Gynae), Senior Resident (Medicine), Senior Resident (Surgery)
basic_details.short_information: Lal Bahadur Shastri Hospital (LBSH), Delhi, has invited applications for 3 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. 8(6)/SR/Estt/LBSH/2026/6627. The posts include Senior Resident (Obs & Gynae), Senior Resident (Medicine), Senior Resident (Surgery). Selection is through a walk-in interview on 12 November 2026.

content_sections.text: Ad-hoc tenure of 44 days, extendable for further 44 days by giving 01 day break on written request recommended by the in-charge Continues till regular incumbent joins, maximum 03 years including earlier Senior Resident service Contract can be terminated by either party with seven days' notice without assigning any reason Selected candidates can be posted anywhere in patient care/public interest in emergency

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for LBSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 12 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in LBSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Senior Resident (Obs & Gynae), 1 Senior Resident (Medicine), 1 Senior Resident (Surgery).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for LBSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 12 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates: No fee for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on the date of advertisement). Relaxation: OBC (valid NCL certificate) 3 years, SC/ST 5 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As per 7th CPC, Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 - 2,008,700) and other admissible allowances per month for Senior Resident (Obs & Gynae), As per 7th CPC, Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 - 2,008,700) and other admissible allowances per month for Senior Resident (Medicine), As per 7th CPC, Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 - 2,008,700) and other admissible allowances per month for Senior Resident (Surgery).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with Post Graduate Degree/DNB/Diploma or Post-Doctoral Degree (or equivalent) in the concerned specialty from an NMC/MCI recognized University/Institute, with DMC registration for the concerned specialty/super specialty. If such candidates are not available, MBBS with 2 years experience in the same specialty can be considered. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. DMC registration for the concerned specialty/super specialty is required. OBC/EWS certificate must be issued by Govt. of NCT of Delhi before the date of interview. NOC from present employer if working in any organization. Joining subject to declaration of medical fitness by the Staff Physician LBSH.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Selection through interview only. Rank list valid till one month from the date of result or the next advertisement of the same post, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ad-hoc tenure of 44 days, extendable for further 44 days by giving 01 day break on written request recommended by the in-charge. Continues till regular incumbent joins, maximum 03 years including earlier Senior Resident service. Contract can be terminated by either party with seven days' notice without assigning any reason.
